overview: Right-click a shulker box in your inventory and its contents open where it sits. The box never leaves your pack.

1.0.4: A shulker box opens after the click that asked for it, not inside it.
A demo to play in PvP Dimensions' onboarding.
1.0.3: Drop changelog notes for changes nothing in the game shows.
1.0.0: A shulker box opens on a chest screen from the slots of any screen you have open.
Take things out, put things in, close it.
